map.热水器容量与升数选型计算器使用指南：说明家庭人数、同时洗澡人数、淋浴时长、花洒流: Water Heater Sizing Calculator Guide: explains household size, simultaneous showers, shower minutes, shower flow and temperatures, then covers storage tank capacity, gas flow rating, instantaneous power and breaker sizing, with examples for a family of three, two bathrooms and a studio.
map.热水器容量与升数选型计算器按家庭人数、同时洗澡人数、淋浴时长与花洒流量，计算混合: The Water Heater Sizing Calculator estimates mixed and 60°C hot-water demand from household size, simultaneous showers, minutes and flow, then recommends storage capacity, gas rating, instantaneous power, breaker and daily cost for renovation and replacement decisions.
map.混合水量 = 同时洗澡人数 × 淋浴时长 × 花洒流量；热水占比 =（目标水温: Mixed water = simultaneous showers × shower minutes × shower flow; hot fraction = (target − inlet) ÷ (tank − inlet); 60°C hot water = mixed water × hot fraction; storage capacity = 60°C hot water ÷ usable fraction (default 80%). Gas ratings use a 25°C rise; instantaneous power = simultaneous flow × 4.186 × rise ÷ 60.
map.选择热水器类型：储水式、燃气或即热式。: Choose the heater type: storage, gas or instantaneous.
map.填写家庭常住人数与同时洗澡人数；两人同时洗按 2 人算，错峰洗按 1 人算。: Enter household size and simultaneous showers; use 2 for two at once and 1 when staggered.
map.填写淋浴时长、花洒流量、进水温度与目标水温；普通花洒约 8 L/min。: Enter shower minutes, shower flow, inlet and target temperatures; a standard showerhead is about 8 L/min.
map.储水式填储水温度与加热功率；燃气与即热式仍填一个功率作参考，燃气结果不显示电费。: For storage, enter tank temperature and heating power; gas and instantaneous still take a reference power, and gas results hide electricity cost.

map.三口之家储水式：1 人同时洗、10 分钟、8 L/min，估算约 56 L，选: Family of three with storage: one shower at a time, 10 minutes, 8 L/min gives about 56 L, so choose 60 L; winter or two simultaneous showers need 80–100 L.
map.双卫燃气：2 人同时洗、各 9 L/min、冬季温升 30°C，单淋浴需约 10: Two bathrooms with gas: two 9 L/min showers and a 30°C winter rise need 10.8 L/min each, about 21.6 L/min total, so choose 24 L or stagger.
map.单身即热：1 人、7 L/min、温升 22°C，约需 10.7 kW，选 12: Single with instantaneous: 7 L/min and a 22°C rise need about 10.7 kW, so choose 12 kW and verify the dedicated line and breaker.
map.三口之家、储水式、1 人同时洗、10 分钟、8 L/min、进水 15°C、目标: Family of three, storage, one shower at a time, 10 minutes, 8 L/min, 15°C inlet, 40°C target, 60°C tank, 2 kW: 80 L mixed water, about 44 L of 60°C water, about 56 L estimated tank, 60 L recommended; a full tank takes about 94 minutes and 3.1 kWh; one daily heat for the family is about 8.7 kWh and CNY 5.2.
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入不上传服务器，结果仅作选型与预算参考。储水容量受内胆结构、: This tool runs entirely in the browser, uploads no inputs, and is for sizing and budgeting only. Storage capacity depends on tank design, insulation, mixing valve and winter inlet temperature; gas ratings are at a 25°C rise, not actual outlet flow; a licensed electrician must verify the dedicated line, breaker and service capacity for instantaneous units. The nameplate, manual and installation conditions still decide.

map.储水式 60 L 够几个人洗？: How many showers does a 60 L storage tank cover?
map.按 40°C 混水、进水 15°C、储水 60°C 估算，60 L 约可供 1: At 40°C mixed, 15°C inlet and 60°C tank, 60 L covers about one 10–12 minute shower; two in a row must wait for reheating, so start at 80 L in winter.
map.燃气 12 L 和 16 L 差多少？: What is the difference between 12 L and 16 L gas ratings?
map.差在温升 25°C 时的额定流量。单卫 8 L/min 淋浴 12 L 足够；双: The difference is rated flow at a 25°C rise. A single 8 L/min shower is fine at 12 L; two simultaneous showers or very cold winter inlet favor 16 L+.
map.即热式一定要改电吗？: Does an instantaneous heater always require electrical work?
map.多数情况要。8 L/min 淋浴约 14 kW，普通 16 A 插座带不动；需独: Usually yes. An 8 L/min shower needs about 14 kW, beyond a standard 16 A socket; it needs a dedicated line and breaker, with an electrician checking service capacity and wire size.
map.容量越大越费电吗？: Does a larger tank use more electricity?
map.加热同样水量所需能量接近，大容量主要增加保温散热与占地。按人数选合适容量，比盲目: Heating the same water takes similar energy; a larger tank mainly adds standby loss and footprint. Sizing to the household saves more than upsizing blindly.
